entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hello, you're speaking with David at VeloFit. How can I help you today?
Oh, hi. Yes. I hope you can help me. I'm a bit overwhelmed. I need to do something about an order I made.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number?
Yes, I think so. It's... VF88602. It was for that Aero Race Jersey. I just... I'm not sure what to do.
Okay, one moment. Yes, I see the order. It looks like that jersey was delivered about two months ago. What specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Preference? I guess? I finally got around to trying it on for a ride and it's the wrong size. It's just way too tight. The website was a little confusing, and I think I ordered incorrectly. I was hoping for an exchange.
I see. So the fit isn't right and you'd like to return the item. Let me just pull up our current return policy for you.
Okay. I was worried I waited too long. All the rules are so hard to follow. Can't you just help me?

Of course. And good news, I've just checked the policy. We accept returns on standard items for up to 90 days after delivery. You're still well within that window, so we can absolutely get this processed for you.
Oh, really? That's such a relief! So you can process the return for the jersey now?

Yes. I'm emailing you a prepaid shipping label right now. Just print it out, attach it to your package, and drop it off with the carrier. Once we receive it, we'll issue a full refund to your original payment method.
That's wonderful! Thank you so much, David. You've made this so much easier.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
